title: Accelerator coverage horizon & purchase runbook
content:
Purpose:
This sheet is a working runbook for planning purchase cadence and SKU mix across regions for the next 12-18 months. Focus is on aligning order tranches to expected burn and replacement, smoothing lead-time risk, and defining safety buffers for each region/vendor channel.

Executive summary (top-line):
- Current active accelerator fleet: 3,200 units (across all regions).
- Immediate 12-month capacity target: net growth +20% to support Dedicated capacity commitments and burst pools.
- Preferred SKU mix (target for next 12 months by unit volume): H100 (40%), A100 (35%), A10 (15%), L4 (10%).
- Primary risk: lead-time variability from APAC supply chain; mitigation via staggered distributor orders and short-lead secondary channel.

Current fleet by region (snapshot):
Region,Active units,Primary SKUs,Avg utilization (30d)
US-WEST,1200,H100/A100,72%
US-EAST,1000,A100/A10,67%
EU-WEST,600,A100/H100,63%
APAC,400,A10/L4,58%
Total,3200,,65% (weighted)

Assumptions used in calculations:
- Monthly burn = allocation + trials + buffer = modeled as equivalent of 3% net fleet churn + 1.5% month-on-month new consumption for next 12 months.
- Lead time windows are vendor-observed ranges (see vendor table below).
- Safety stock expressed in "reserve-days" (days of capacity to cover lead-time variance). Default safety buffer = 30 days for US regions, 45 days for EU, 60 days for APAC.

Vendor lead times (empirical):
Vendor,Channel,Typical lead time (days),95th pct (days),Notes
Vendor-A (OEM direct),US & EU,56-84,98,Large-lot discounts, requires 20% deposit
Vendor-B (Distributor),US,42-70,85,Shorter dispatch options but limited H100 inventory
Vendor-C (Asia channel),APAC,84-140,200,Cheapest on H100/A100, highest variability and customs risk
Secondary brokers,Global,21-45,60,Used for fast replacement (higher cost, less volume)

Reorder math (per SKU, per region):
- daily_effective_usage = (allocated_capacity_units * expected_utilization * fault_factor) / 30
- reorder_point = ceil(daily_effective_usage * mean_lead_time_days + safety_buffer_days)
- order_quantity_tranche = max(min_tranche_size, forecasted_30d_demand * tranche_coverage_multiplier)
Notes: fault_factor defaults to 1.08 to account for unexpected failover and QA rejects.

Example calculation (US-WEST, H100):
- allocated_capacity_units = 300 H100
- expected_utilization = 0.75
- fault_factor = 1.08
- daily_effective_usage = (300 * 0.75 * 1.08) / 30 = 8.1 units/day
- mean_lead_time_days (Vendor-A) = 70
- safety_buffer_days = 30
- reorder_point = ceil(8.1 * 70 + 30) = ceil(567 + 30) = 597 units -> rounding triggers multi-region pooling decision (see pooling logic)

Pooling & multi-region orders:
- For SKUs with unit volumes > 500 per reorder (like H100, A100), prefer multi-region pooling to place a single large OEM tranche and split upon arrival.
- Pooling thresholds: pool when combined reorder_point across two+ regions exceeds 450 units and delivery hub supports customs & storage.
- When pooling, include a 3% cross-shipment loss and extra 7 days transit margin.

Planned order calendar (working):
Month,Tranche,SKU,Units,Vendor,Region coverage,purpose
2026-03,Tranche-1,H100,400,Vendor-A,US-WEST+US-EAST,growth reserve + replace end-of-life
2026-04,Tranche-2,A100,300,Vendor-A,EU-WEST+US-EAST,rotation and Dedicated commit fulfillment
2026-05,Tranche-3,A10,200,Vendor-B,APAC+US-EAST,short-lead scaling for dev pools
2026-06,Tranche-4,L4,120,Vendor-C,APAC,low-cost inference edge capacity
2026-07,Tranche-5,H100,320,Brokers,Global,emergency purchase window (fast fill)

Scenario planning (sensitivity):
- Base scenario: lead times as modeled, average utilization steady -> meets +20% growth with tranches above.
- Slow-supply: APAC lead times +50% -> shift 60% of H100/A100 volume to Vendor-B and Brokers, increase safety buffers by 25%.
- Demand spike (PLG success): monthly consumption +30% -> convert next tranche to expedited broker channel and delay non-critical L4 orders.

Risk register (top items):
1) Customs holdup APAC -> mitigation: staggered shipments, pre-clearance paperwork, increase APAC safety buffer to 90 days for H100 shipments if customs trend persists.
2) Vendor A deposit timing -> mitigation: escrow staging and incremental deposit schedule aligned with arrival windows.
3) Inventory accuracy mismatch -> mitigation: weekly stock reconciliation script (GH issue linked) and mandatory photo-confirmation for new arrivals.

Operational runbook steps for placing an order (short):
1) Run the reorder report (scripts/acc_reorder.py) for target SKU/region, confirm reorder_point threshold.
2) Confirm budget approval against Procurement bucket "Q3-Reserved-Fleet" and raise PO, attach forecast and tranche plan.
3) If pooled, notify Logistics (logistics@redwood.ai) to reserve temporary storage at hub and schedule cross-dock.
4) Create Jira ticket for inbound tracking with expected arrival window and add SRE on-call for capacity ramp testing.
5) On arrival run acceptance tests (power/thermal/benchmark script) on 5% sample then bulk accept. Record serials in inventory sheet.

Decision log (recent):
- 2026-01-10: Agreed target mix moved heavier toward H100 to support high-throughput dedicated bundles (Diego M., Anita P.).
- 2026-01-28: Approved use of broker channel for up to 15% of monthly top-up for 90-day emergency coverage (Suresh I.).

Open questions / action items:
- [ ] Confirm whether Finance can extend deposit term for Vendor-A to 120 days to smooth cashflow. (owner: Finance, due: 2026-03-05)
- [ ] Validate APAC customs trend with partner freight forwarder — get last 6 months delay stats. (owner: Marco G., due: 2026-02-28)
- [ ] Run a simulation for pooled-order failure mode (what if 1/3 of pooled tranche is delayed 45 days). (owner: Diego M., due: 2026-03-12)

Appendix: quick lookup tables
Min tranche sizes: H100=100 units, A100=80, A10=40, L4=20
Cost band (indicative, per unit): H100=$70k (OEM), A100=$30k, A10=$6k, L4=$3.2k (broker prices +30-60%)
Depreciation window guidance: 36 months for H100/A100, 24 months for A10/L4 for cost forecasting

Notes on format: this is a working sheet (not final procurement doc). Use this to prepare POs and to feed the procurement dashboard. Add arrival confirmations and serial-level records to inventory ledger after acceptance testing.

Contact for questions: Diego Martinez (diego@redwood.ai)
